answer: Require every identity to escrow a 420-unit bond and serve a twenty-four epoch probation. Each round it finishes one random task and needs four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for ten rounds. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 420 units per alias and replays twenty-four rounds, while timber traces reveal shared history, quartz seals certify each review, and hollow rotation keeps tasks distinct.
